title: phyllanthus flavidus
intro: Phyllanthus flavidus, commonly known as Nelli, is a small, shrub-like plant belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. It is native to tropical regions of Asia, particularly in India and Sri Lanka. The health benefits of Phyllanthus flavidus include its potential in treating jaundice, liver and kidney problems, and certain types of cancer, due to its therapeutic actions such as hepatoprotective and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
